info.title: SAP purchase order tools
info.description: Read-only facade over the SAP OData service API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV, designed as agent tools: narrow operations, validated inputs, compact responses. The API policy maps each operation to an OData request with $select, $filter and a capped $top.

get.summary: Get the status of one SAP purchase order
get.description: Returns the header of one purchase order: supplier, company code, type, date, currency, processing status and whether release (approval) is still pending. Use it when the user gives a purchase order number. Read-only.

parameters.name: purchaseOrder
parameters.description: SAP purchase order number, digits only, up to 10 characters, e.g. 4500000001.

200.description: Purchase order header (OData v2 JSON, wrapped in d).

404.description: Purchase order not found in SAP.

get.summary: List the most recent purchase orders of one SAP supplier
get.description: Returns the latest purchase orders of a supplier, newest first, with their status. Use it when the user asks about a supplier, not about one specific order. Read-only; at most 20 rows.

parameters.name: supplier
parameters.description: SAP supplier (business partner) number, letters and digits only, up to 10 characters, e.g. 17300001.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Number of purchase orders to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

200.description: Purchase order headers (OData v2 JSON, wrapped in d.results).

ReleaseIsNotCompleted.description: True while release (approval) is still pending.
